people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;
translations.bsb: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
translations.kjv: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
translations.asv: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
